name: sp_api_find
description: Find existing Sea Power business APIs by short query (Chinese or English) or domain. Returns brief signatures and practical notes; no source/doc reading. Call sp_api_schema for exact selected schemas. Discovery does not execute game commands.

name: sp_api_schema
description: Get exact existing MCP schemas plus important Bridge caveats and short workflows for selected APIs. Always describe selected tools before calling; do not guess arguments.

name: sp_api_call
description: Worker only: invoke one existing Sea Power API within your mcp_task ticket. Requires private capability. A call_id is an idempotency key: reuse it for the same invocation. An uncertain write is NEVER replayed. Read returned error/status before proceeding. Images are saved as local artifacts for read_image/view_image.

name: sp_api_finish
description: Worker only: report factual task outcome and end. All calls are checked against host receipts. Never report fulfilled when you only inspected but did not execute the requested order. blocked/needs_input may end without calls, with a concrete reason. Unknown writes remain uncertain. Immediately exit; do not monitor or contact the main agent.

outcome.description: Task result, separate from API success. Use blocked/needs_input when no authorized action can be taken. fulfilled is a worker claim, not verified battle effects.

reason.description: Concrete blocker or required clarification; required for blocked/needs_input.
